workflows.scenario: Start a new NGPF Bank Simulator session from the public landing page, verify the dashboard summary is usable, and view the read-only checking account transaction history.
preconditions: Playwright launches a fresh, unauthenticated browser context with no prior bank simulator session state

steps.action: Open the NGPF Bank Simulator landing page
steps.expected: The landing page renders with a GET STARTED NOW button

steps.action: Start a new simulator session by clicking GET STARTED NOW
steps.expected: The browser navigates from /bank-sim/home to the simulator dashboard at /bank-sim/

steps.action: Dismiss the one-time welcome dialog on the dashboard
steps.expected: The welcome dialog closes (detaches) and the dashboard remains on screen

steps.action: Verify the checking account summary card is usable on the dashboard
steps.expected: The checking account card is visible and shows an AVAILABLE BALANCE label

steps.action: Open the checking account activity by clicking VIEW ACCOUNT on the checking card
steps.expected: The browser navigates to the account activity page for the checking account (/bank-sim/account?type=checking)

steps.action: Confirm the account activity page has loaded
steps.expected: The Account Activity heading is visible

steps.action: Confirm the Checking toggle is the active account selection
steps.expected: The Checking toggle button carries the active state class

steps.action: Confirm a read-only transaction history is displayed for the checking account
steps.expected: The transactions table is visible with its header row plus at least one data row

workflows.test: generated_tests/www.ngpf.org/playwright_tests/tests/account-activity.spec.ts#starts a bank simulator session and views checking account activity
